“ The road to a brighter future is paved with knowledge, and we are committed to ensuring that every girl student has access to this road and the opportunity to chase their dreams.”

Malabar Scholarship for girl students is a targeted initiative started in 2007 designed to enhance access, retention, and academic progression of girl students in government academic institutions, particularly those from economically and socially disadvantaged backgrounds. The scheme provides financial assistance to support educational needs, reduce dropout rates, and ensure continuity in studies. The program aims to empower girls with confidence, self-respect, and independence.
Till date we have provided scholarships to 1.45 Lakh girls students across 18 States and 3 UT spent over 104 Crore.

To alleviate the financial burden of girl students from government schools and their families by providing financial assistance towards education-related expenses, such as tuition fees, books, and study materials.
To empower young girls to become confident, self-reliant, and self-sufficient individuals who can make informed decisions about their lives.
To recognize and support the academic achievements of talented and meritorious girl students from government schools, encouraging them to strive for excellence in their studies.
The scholarship will be granted to eligible candidates based on the following criteria, subject to fund availability:
Girl students who are presently pursuing higher education in Higher Secondary level in government schools located in selected Indian states.
Applicants must have successfully completed the 10th grade with a minimum of 50% marks.
Preference will be given to students with the highest marks and the lowest family income.
Students must be enrolled in a full-time, regular academic program. Distance and correspondence students are not eligible to apply.

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria will undergo an evaluation based on the socio-economic and educational parameters of their applications. In addition to meeting the eligibility requirements, priority will be given to those who achieve higher scores against the specified criteria:
Aggregate percentage of marks in the qualifying examination
History of chronic illness in immediate family members
Cancer, Stroke, Kidney Disease, heart Disease & other severe conditions
Based on the selection score acquired, applicants will receive an amount ( as RTGs) as follows.

All candidates are required to submit an online application as specified by the Malabar Charitable Trust. Candidates must note that the application is location specific. Applications for scholarships are collected from nearby locations around Malabar Gold and Diamonds showrooms.
Step-by-step process for applying for the scholarship are:
Thoroughly review the scholarship details to ensure you meet the eligibility criteria.
Register on the Malabar Charitable Trust website by clicking on the following link:
Complete the online application form, attaching all the required documents. After submitting the application, you will receive a confirmation text message on your mobile phone.
Within three days of receiving the confirmation message, submit the hard copies of your application form along with the supporting documents at your nearest Malabar Gold & Diamond Showroom.
Malabar Charitable Trust team will verify and review all submitted documents.

The application will then undergo a thorough evaluation, and a final decision will be made regarding its approval or rejection. Successful applicants will be notified through a text message sent to their registered mobile phone number. Please note that due to the high volume of applications, Malabar Charitable Trust do not send rejection notifications to applicants.
Once approved, the allocated funds will be disbursed to applicant's bank account via RTGS (Real-Time Gross Settlement).

NB: Malabar Charitable Trust and Malabar Gold & Diamonds do not charge any fees for any scholarship-related services from applicants. If anyone demands fees or commissions, students can report it here.
Bank Passbook (In case of merged banks, attach the latest passbook)

First-year higher secondary students should provide their 10th-grade public exam mark sheet as the qualifying exam document. Second-year students should submit their higher secondary first-year mark sheet.
Proof of family income (Income Certificate from local body)

The scholarship application period typically opens in the first week of July and closes on December 31st each year. However, the scholarship distribution is not time-specific; it may be disbursed at any point during the academic year, and there are no fixed dates for release.

This specific scholarship is exclusively intended for girl students from outside Kerala. Under no circumstances can male students apply for this scholarship.
This scholarship program is exclusively for girl students in government schools. Students studying in private, aided, or unaided schools/colleges are not eligible to apply.

Typically, it takes one to three months time to credit the scholarship amount. The amount will be disbursed as an RTGS cheque to the applicant during a public event organized by Malabar Gold and Diamonds showroom in your nearest location.
When to Apply for the Scholarship?

Scholarship application timelines vary based on different factors in each location. Generally, we commence accepting applications between July and September each year. We highly recommend contacting the nearest Malabar Gold and Diamonds showroom for the precise deadline.

The scholarship amount varies for each applicant, adhering strictly to selection criteria and assessment. The maximum amount eligible applicants would receive is Rs. 10,000/-, while the minimum amount is Rs. 6,000/-.
